final_proposal.thesis: This portfolio balances aggressive growth potential with rigorous risk management to satisfy an MBA graduate's desire for alpha while ensuring every position is fundamentally sound and stable enough to justify a minimum 12% allocation. By capping technology at exactly 39% using only the safest high-growth names (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL), we capture tech upside without violating risk constraints. The remaining 61% is diversified across Financials (JPM), Healthcare (JNJ), Consumer Staples (KO, PG), and Energy (XOM), all selected for their low correlations, strong fundamentals, or defensive qualities, ensuring no single position exposes the portfolio to unacceptable volatility or drawdown risk. NEEDS ADVISOR APPROVAL: These rules can't all hold: 'At least 9 different stocks for diversification', 'And every position at least 12%, so each one matters'. Cheapest fix (needs advisor approval): Lower 'And every position at least 12%, so each one matters' from 12.0% to 11.1% (cost 4 x 0.8889 points = 3.5556).

reasons.AAPL: Selected by the risk agent as a stable, low-volatility tech anchor to maximize the allowed 39% tech cap without the excessive drawdown risks of NVDA or META.
reasons.MSFT: Chosen by both macro and fundamental agents as the highest-quality tech holding with strong momentum and margins, serving as the core growth engine within the strict sector limit.
reasons.GOOGL: Included for its superior fundamental value (low P/E, high growth) and is permitted by the risk agent as one of the few acceptable tech names beyond MSFT/AAPL.
reasons.JPM: The only financial selected by the macro agent for its relative strength and best-in-class status, avoiding the deeper drawdowns seen in BAC and GS.
reasons.JNJ: Selected by the risk agent for near-zero correlation to the market and lowest drawdown, providing essential defensive diversification against tech/financial volatility.
reasons.PG: Selected by the risk agent for its low correlation and stability, complementing KO to provide robust consumer staple diversification.
reasons.KO: Included for its solid margins, positive growth, and defensive characteristics, acting as a key stabilizer alongside PG and JNJ.
reasons.WMT: Excluded due to extremely high P/E and low margin, making it overvalued and stagnant compared to other consumer staples like KO and PG.
reasons.XOM: Selected for its strong momentum and energy sector outperformance, providing commodity exposure with lower correlation than CVX.
